limitations: This commit contains only original static plans, properties, metadata, worker-local text inputs, and schema-only projections; it contains no JMeter archive, keystore, JTL, log, or runner script.
The pinned Java/JMeter runtime is not provisioned for this static task, so no RMI worker, SSL, sender, retry, stop, or remote-exit observation is claimed.

The external runner must allocate the complete base+0..7 loopback block, stage each worker's distinct worker-local.txt and dependency marker, generate temporary JKS material for SSL cases, and record raw evidence outside the repository.
Static plan configuration (threads, loop iterations, queue bounds, and retry bounds) is input metadata, not an observed sample count or process result.

For Asynch and StrippedAsynch, TestEnded-before-final-sentinel/processBatch ordering is source observation only; execution is capability-unavailable until a positive SenderDrainProof hook observes sentinel consumption and sender-thread termination.
DIST-004 is represented by worker-local CSVDataSet probes, a worker-classpath reference, client decoy inputs, and a dynamic iteration marker; transfer behavior remains external and unverified.

The partial-worker failure cases prescribe withholding worker-b registry/engine before startup and classify the expected java.rmi.ConnectException as a startup-connect failure; no exception was observed in static validation.
TEST-004 is not included because this standalone case does not cover the recorder half of the distributed/recorder/TLS integration union.
